title.zh: 新加坡 > 吉隆坡 > 乌鲁木齐

title.en: Depart for Urumqi via Kuala Lumpur
title.zh: 经吉隆坡飞往乌鲁木齐

description.en: Depart from Singapore via Kuala Lumpur on a flight to Urumqi. Upon arrival, meet your local guide and transfer by coach to the hotel for check-in and rest.
description.zh: 搭乘航班从新加坡途中经过吉隆坡飞往乌鲁木齐。抵达后由专业导游接机，乘坐旅游巴士前往酒店办理入住并休息。

description.en: Breakfast / Lunch / Dinner
description.zh: 早餐 / 午餐 / 晚餐

description.en: After breakfast, travel by coach to Fuyun.
description.zh: 早餐后乘车前往富蕴。

description.en: Pass through the Kalamaili Nature Reserve and admire Northern Xinjiang’s vast desert, Gobi and protected wildlife landscapes.
description.zh: 沿途经过【卡拉麦里自然保护区】，欣赏北疆辽阔荒漠、戈壁及野生动物自然保护区景观。

trip_items.photo_subject: Kalamaili Nature Reserve 卡拉麦里自然保护区

description.en: Check in to the hotel upon arrival.
description.zh: 抵达富蕴后入住酒店休息。

description.en: Breakfast / Lunch / -
description.zh: 早餐 / 午餐 / -

description.en: Visit Keketuohai Scenic Area and admire its dramatic mountains, river valleys and forest landscapes.
description.zh: 游览【可可托海景区】，欣赏峡谷、河流、森林及雄伟山峦交织而成的自然景观。

trip_items.photo_subject: Keketuohai Scenic Area 可可托海景区

description.en: Continue by coach to Burqin.
description.zh: 随后乘车前往布尔津。

description.en: In the evening, explore the Burqin Riverside Night Market and discover local Xinjiang snacks at your own leisure.
description.zh: 晚上前往【河堤夜市】，自由感受当地夜市气氛并品尝新疆特色小吃。

trip_items.photo_subject: Burqin Riverside Night Market 布尔津河堤夜市

description.en: Breakfast / Lunch / Dinner
description.zh: 早餐 / 午餐 / 晚餐

description.en: Travel to Jiadengyu after breakfast.
description.zh: 早餐后乘车前往贾登峪。

description.en: Visit the magnificent Kanas Lake, surrounded by mountains and pristine forests.
description.zh: 游览著名的【喀纳斯湖】，欣赏湖泊、雪山及原始森林组成的北疆经典风景。

trip_items.photo_subject: Kanas Lake 喀纳斯湖

description.en: Explore the famous Three Bays of Kanas and admire the river winding through the valleys and forest landscapes.
description.zh: 游览【喀纳斯三湾】，感受河流在森林与山谷间蜿蜒而过的壮丽景观。

trip_items.photo_subject: Kanas Three Bays 喀纳斯三湾

title.zh: 贾登峪 > 禾木 > 布尔津

description.en: Breakfast / Lunch / Dinner
description.zh: 早餐 / 午餐 / 晚餐

description.en: Visit Hemu Village, one of China’s most beautiful mountain villages.
description.zh: 早餐后前往有“中国最美村落”之称的【禾木村】。

trip_items.photo_subject: Hemu Village 禾木村

description.en: Enter the village by electric cart and admire its traditional wooden houses, forests, rivers and mountain scenery.
description.zh: 乘坐景区电瓶车进入村落，欣赏图瓦木屋、森林、河流及雪山交织而成的宁静景色。

trip_items.photo_subject: Hemu Village Tuvan Wooden Houses 禾木村图瓦木屋

description.en: Continue to Colourful Beach, renowned for its colourful rock formations beside the Irtysh River.
description.zh: 随后游览【五彩滩】，欣赏多彩雅丹地貌与额尔齐斯河形成的独特自然景观。

trip_items.photo_subject: Colourful Beach Burqin 布尔津五彩滩

description.en: Return to Burqin and check in to the hotel.
description.zh: 返回布尔津入住酒店。

description.en: Breakfast / Lunch / Dinner
description.zh: 早餐 / 午餐 / 晚餐

description.en: Travel to Kuitun after breakfast.
description.zh: 早餐后乘车前往奎屯。

description.en: Visit Urho Ghost City, a spectacular Yadan landform shaped by centuries of wind erosion.
description.zh: 途中游览【乌尔禾魔鬼城】，欣赏长期受风力侵蚀形成的雅丹地貌及奇特岩石景观。

trip_items.photo_subject: Urho Ghost City 乌尔禾魔鬼城

description.en: Continue to Kuitun and check in to the hotel upon arrival.
description.zh: 游览结束后继续前往奎屯，抵达后入住酒店。

title.zh: 奎屯 > 赛里木湖 > 果子沟 > 可可达拉

description.en: Breakfast / Lunch / Dinner
description.zh: 早餐 / 午餐 / 晚餐

description.en: Visit Sayram Lake, famously known as the “Last Tear of the Atlantic”, and admire its brilliant blue waters surrounded by mountains and grasslands.
description.zh: 前往被誉为“大西洋最后一滴眼泪”的【赛里木湖】，欣赏高山、草原及湛蓝湖水。

trip_items.photo_subject: Sayram Lake 赛里木湖

description.en: Pass the spectacular Guozigou Bridge and enjoy the valley scenery.
description.zh: 途经壮观的【果子沟大桥】，欣赏伊犁河谷山谷景色。

trip_items.photo_subject: Guozigou Bridge 果子沟大桥

description.en: Visit the Lavender Museum to learn about Ili’s lavender-growing culture.
description.zh: 参观【薰衣草博物馆】，了解伊犁薰衣草种植及加工文化。

trip_items.photo_subject: Ili Lavender Museum 伊犁薰衣草博物馆

description.en: Continue to Kokdala and check in to the hotel.
description.zh: 随后前往可可达拉入住酒店。

description.en: Breakfast / Lunch / Dinner
description.zh: 早餐 / 午餐 / 晚餐

sections._note: 英文 4 条 ✦、中文 3 条 ✦：中文第 2 条把英文第 2 条(乘区间车进入草原腹地)与第 3 条(欣赏雪山森林河谷草原)合并成一句，故此处按语义合并为 3 个 trip_items。

description.en: Travel to Nalati after breakfast.
description.zh: 早餐后乘车前往那拉提。

title.zh: 那拉提空中草原（含景区区间车）

description.en: Visit the magnificent Nalati Sky Grassland and take a scenic shuttle into the heart of the grassland. Admire the surrounding mountains, forests, valleys and open grasslands.
description.zh: 游览【那拉提空中草原】，乘坐景区区间车进入草原腹地，欣赏雪山、森林、河谷及广阔草原。

trip_items.photo_subject: Nalati Sky Grassland 那拉提空中草原

description.en: In the evening, enjoy a lively Grassland Bonfire Party featuring local music and dance.
description.zh: 晚上参加【草原篝火晚会】，感受新疆少数民族歌舞与热情氛围。

trip_items.photo_subject: Xinjiang Grassland Bonfire Party 新疆草原篝火晚会

title.zh: 那拉提 > 独库公路 > 奎屯

description.en: Breakfast / Lunch / -
description.zh: 早餐 / 午餐 / -

description.en: When the Duku Highway is open, transfer to a smaller vehicle and travel approximately six hours along the scenic highway to Kuitun.
description.zh: 若独库公路开放，将换乘小型车辆，沿独库公路行驶约6小时返回奎屯。

trip_items.photo_subject: Duku Highway 独库公路

description.en: Enjoy views of the Tianshan Mountains, valleys and grasslands along the way.
description.zh: 沿途欣赏天山山脉、峡谷、草原及季节性公路风光。

trip_items.photo_subject: Tianshan Mountains 天山山脉

description.en: Breakfast / Lunch / Dinner
description.zh: 早餐 / 午餐 / 晚餐

description.en: Under the Duku Highway route, travel approximately 440 kilometres from Kuitun to Turpan.
description.zh: 则从奎屯乘车约440公里、6小时前往吐鲁番。

description.en: Visit the historic Karez Well upon arrival.
description.zh: 抵达后游览【坎儿井】。

trip_items.photo_subject: Karez Well Turpan 吐鲁番坎儿井

description.en: Breakfast / Lunch / Dinner
description.zh: 早餐 / 午餐 / 晚餐

description.en: Visit the famous Flaming Mountains and admire their dramatic red desert landscape.
description.zh: 早餐后游览吐鲁番著名景点【火焰山】，欣赏独特的红色山体及荒漠地貌。

trip_items.photo_subject: Flaming Mountains Turpan 吐鲁番火焰山

description.en: Enjoy a Uyghur Family Visit and learn about local customs and daily life.
description.zh: 参加【维吾尔族家访】，了解当地家庭生活及民族文化。

trip_items.photo_subject: Uyghur Family Home Visit Turpan 吐鲁番维吾尔族家访

description.en: Take part in a traditional Naan-Making Experience.
description.zh: 体验传统【打馕活动】，亲手了解新疆馕饼的制作过程。

trip_items.photo_subject: Xinjiang Naan Making 新疆打馕

description.en: Return to Urumqi by coach.
description.zh: 随后乘车返回乌鲁木齐。

title.en: Urumqi Free Time > Kuala Lumpur > Singapore
title.zh: 乌鲁木齐自由活动 > 吉隆坡 > 新加坡

description.en: Breakfast / - / -
Enjoy free time in Urumqi after breakfast.
description.zh: 早餐后于乌鲁木齐自由活动。

description.en: Transfer to the airport in the evening for the return flight.
description.zh: 晚上前往机场，搭乘返程航班。

description.en: Carrying sweet memories of Xinjiang.
description.zh: 带着满满的新疆回忆返回新加坡。
